captions: At Wrenhaven Scores, a parcel label cuts Ängsö's name and drops two dots.
The label drops the last dots, the count is too high, and the name seems new.
You catch it in a test, work by what a person sees, and test another alphabet.
Now names stay whole on labels, count right and match their accounts.
Same name, same choir. One account and a whole label.
